channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
item.description: What is “the true cost of a token”? (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
item.description: I am a dermatologist. I tested the ability of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 to diagnosis skin cancer and found that they were less accurate than I expected. I compared to a 10-year old CNN and to my surprise found that this was superior. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
Article: The Evolution of Agentic Harnesses: From Chains to Graph to Code
item.description: Agentic LLM systems have moved from linear prompt chains to graph-based workflows and, more recently, code-executing harnesses. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare’s Auto Router Rates Each Request for Stakes, from the Most Recent Turns
item.description: Cloudflare has released Auto Router in public beta through AI Gateway, picking a model per request from a classifier that scores complexity, ambiguity, stakes and context dependence. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: PyTorch Conference 2026: Google and Meta Open-Source TorchTPU for Native PyTorch on TPUs
item.description: Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Google's TPUs, at PyTorch Conference North America 2026, and Meta said it plans to move larger LLM workloads onto TPUs with it. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: “AI Skills” are worthless in 2026
item.description: And yet, in five years, I’m sure there will be old heads doggedly adding “you are an experienced software developer, make no mistakes” to their custom instructions. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Google ML Drift Accelerates On-Device AI Inference Across Diverse GPUs
item.description: Google has released ML Drift, an open-source, cross-platform GPU compute engine designed for on-device AI and machine learning inference. (1 source: infoq)
